scope.flow: L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager
scope.environment: Solidity smart contract using block.timestamp as deadline

statements.text: The increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call passes block.timestamp as the deadline argument to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager.
Because the deadline equals the mining-time block.timestamp, the deadline check compares block.timestamp against the same value and is a no-op.
Pending transactions without a proper deadline can be executed at a later time.
Malicious actors or MEV bots could execute delayed transactions at a disadvantage to the original submitter.
increaseLiquidityCurrentRange should supply a deadline that bounds when the transaction may be mined, so a pending transaction cannot be executed at an arbitrarily later time.

ambiguities: No concrete attacker action or transaction sequence is described; the report only states a capability (could execute delayed transactions).
The report does not establish that a specific pending transaction was actually delayed or exploited.
The report does not specify the exact disadvantage or value lost to the original submitter.
